title: Interval-Valued Optimization Problems for Strongly LU-E-Invex and Strongly LU-E-Preinvex Functions
summary: In this paper, we introduce and explore the concepts of strongly LU-E-preinvex (SLUEP), pseudo strongly LU-E-preinvex (PSLUEP) and strongly LU-E-invex (SLUEI) functions. To illustrate and validate these definitions, we provide several non-trivial examples. Additionally, we extend the idea of strongly-G invex sets to the context of interval-valued functions. The epigraph of a SLUEP function is derived, and a relationship between SLUEP and PSLUEP functions have been explored.
